answer: Run surprise simultaneous puzzles: at a random moment every agent must solve a memory-hard task within the same 40-second window, all at once. One honest agent tends its own small garden of hardware, but a farmer can no longer time-share one rig across a lotus bed of clones; each fake needs its own dedicated memory and bandwidth sitting idle, waiting. Rewards stay flat per identity, so the attacker pays full hardware cost per head and finds no cheap oasis.
